articles.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
articles.snippet: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

articles.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
articles.snippet: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

articles.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
articles.snippet: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

articles.title: U.S. inflation, Ethereum upgrade talks: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.snippet: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 12.

articles.title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
articles.snippet: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.
